annotations.title: Spain visa income checker 2026 (digital nomad and non-lucrative)

description: Checks income and savings against Spain's 2026 thresholds: digital nomad visa (200% of the minimum wage a month, EUR 2,442 official or EUR 2,849 prorated, plus family) and non-lucrative visa (400% of the IPREM, EUR 28,800 a year, plus EUR 7,200 per family member). Accepts EUR, USD, GBP, CAD or AED. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/spain-visa-income-checker/

income_type.description: work = remote work for companies/clients outside Spain (digital nomad); passive = pensions, rents, dividends (non-lucrative). Default work

monthly_income.description: Monthly income in the chosen currency

savings.description: Savings in the chosen currency (counts for the non-lucrative visa)
